question.questionText: The Antarctic is the…. continent on earth.
question.explanationHtml:
Detailed Explanation:
The blank in the sentence 'The Antarctic is the…. continent on earth.' requires a superlative adjective because we are comparing the Antarctic to all other continents on earth. In English, the superlative form is used to show that something has the highest degree of a quality among three or more things. The correct superlative form of 'cold' is 'coldest.'
  • cold (adjective): This is the base form of the adjective. It is used to describe something that has a low temperature, but it is not used for comparisons.
  • colder (comparative adjective): This is the comparative form of the adjective 'cold.' It is used to compare two things (e.g., 'Antarctica is colder than Africa').
  • coldest (superlative adjective): This is the superlative form of the adjective 'cold.' It is used to compare three or more things and shows the highest degree (e.g., 'Antarctica is the coldest continent').
  • most coldly (superlative adverb): 'Coldly' is an adverb, and 'most coldly' is the superlative form of the adverb. However, we need an adjective to describe the noun 'continent,' not an adverb.
Related structure or vocabulary: Superlative adjectives: the + adjective-est (for short adjectives) or the most + adjective (for long adjectives). Used to show the highest degree among three or more things.

  • colder (tính từ so sánh hơn): Đây là dạng so sánh hơn của tính từ 'cold', dùng để so sánh hai vật/sự việc (ví dụ: 'Antarctica is colder than Africa').
  • coldest (tính từ so sánh nhất): Đây là dạng so sánh nhất của tính từ 'cold', dùng để so sánh ba hoặc nhiều vật/sự việc và chỉ mức độ cao nhất (ví dụ: 'Antarctica is the coldest continent').
  • most coldly (trạng từ so sánh nhất): 'Coldly' là trạng từ, 'most coldly' là dạng so sánh nhất của trạng từ này. Tuy nhiên, chúng ta cần một tính từ để bổ nghĩa cho danh từ 'continent', không phải trạng từ.
